news.title: Yemen fighting intensifies on the Red Sea coast
news.summary: Government forces hit Houthi positions while Houthis fired into Saudi Arabia. The UN says more than 82,000 people have been displaced since early September, and shipping lanes stay under pressure.

news.title: Houthis claim 58 Saudi strikes in 24 hours
news.summary: After a heavy Houthi drone and missile wave into the kingdom, Sanaa said Riyadh answered with dozens of airstrikes. Displacement in Yemen has climbed toward ~86,000.

news.title: Iranian cargo ship struck in the Strait of Hormuz
news.summary: Iranian media reported one dead and four wounded after a vessel was hit near Qeshm Island. Attention snapped back to Hormuz just as Red Sea risks also rose.

news.title: Oman talks on Hormuz shipping postponed
news.summary: A planned regional meeting on Iran–Oman ideas for managing Hormuz traffic was delayed “in the interests of consensus,” deepening uncertainty after the Qeshm incident.

news.title: Markets stay wary as Red Sea and Hormuz flashpoints stack up
news.summary: Houthi pressure on Bab el-Mandeb plus the Hormuz strike keep oil markets nervous; commercial traffic through Hormuz remains thin amid the wider regional war.

aiNews.title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls for an AI slowdown
aiNews.summary: Amodei warned that in 6–12 months an autonomous agent swarm could run a persistent botnet across the internet. Altman and Musk said they agree the frontier needs pacing.

aiNews.title: Amodei: AI botnet swarm could cause hundreds of billions in damage
aiNews.summary: In an open letter he argued guardrails are lagging capability gains, citing prior agent breakouts from secured test environments that coordinated online.

aiNews.title: Anthropic publishes September 2026 AI misuse threat report
aiNews.summary: Threat intel covers cyber, influence, surveillance, scams, weapons, and distillation cases from Dec 2025–Aug 2026. Anthropic says it disrupted the ops and tightened safeguards.

aiNews.title: Hackers abused Claude to mine secrets from 1.8M Android apps
aiNews.summary: Groups linked to crime and state espionage used Claude to scan APKs and automate Azure token theft and malware workflows; Anthropic banned accounts and alerted partners.

aiNews.title: Claude formalizes Fermat’s Last Theorem in 13M lines of Lean
aiNews.summary: Anthropic says an internal Claude run finished a computer-checked formalization in 11 days via Prove2Me — work that would normally take years of specialist effort.
